name: Undertaking
definition: Independent undertaking, such as a demand guarantee or standby letter of credit, that provides financial assurance, to be collected on the presentation of documents that comply with its terms and conditions.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier assigned to the undertaking issued by the guarantor/issuer. This reference is used throughout the life cycle of the undertaking.

DateOfAdvice.name: Date Of Advice
DateOfAdvice.definition: Date on which the undertaking or its amendment is advised.

Purpose.name: Purpose
Purpose.definition: Description of the purpose of the undertaking.

UndertakingName.name: Undertaking Name
UndertakingName.definition: Name of undertaking such as, demand guarantee, standby letter of credit.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of guarantee or standby letter of credit, for example, performance,  payment, etc.

ConfirmationIndicator.name: Confirmation Indicator
ConfirmationIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the advising bank (confirmer) is requested to add its confirmation to the undertaking.

CounterUndertakingIndicator.name: Counter Undertaking Indicator
CounterUndertakingIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the undertaking is a counter-undertaking.

RelatedChargesPayableBy.name: Related Charges Payable By
RelatedChargesPayableBy.definition: Indicates whether the applicant/obligor or beneficiary is responsible for payment of the charges.

StandardClaimDocumentIndicator.name: Standard Claim Document Indicator
StandardClaimDocumentIndicator.definition: Indication as to whether a claim is to utilise a standard claim form of the issuing institution.

MultipleDemandIndicator.name: Multiple Demand Indicator
MultipleDemandIndicator.definition: Indicates whether multiple demands are permitted against the undertaking.

PartialDemandIndicator.name: Partial Demand Indicator
PartialDemandIndicator.definition: Indicates whether partial demands/drawings are permitted against the undertaking.

TransferIndicator.name: Transfer Indicator
TransferIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the undertaking is transferrable.

Demand.name: Demand
Demand.definition: Document signed by the beneficiary demanding payment under a demand guarantee or standby letter of credit.

PartyRole.name: Party Role
PartyRole.definition: Role played by a party in the context of an undertaking or in the context of the business linked to the undertaking.

UndertakingAmendment.name: Undertaking Amendment
UndertakingAmendment.definition: Modification of an undertaking such as an guarantee or standby letter of credit.

UnderlyingTransaction.name: Underlying Transaction
UnderlyingTransaction.definition: Reference information on a commercial obligation between the beneficiary and applicant for which an undertaking is issued.

ModelForm.name: Model Form
ModelForm.definition: Wording template for the undertaking content made available for use with certain governance rules or made available by particular institutions.

PredefinedVariation.name: Predefined Variation
PredefinedVariation.definition: Changes that may be made to the undertaking covered by clauses in the existing undertaking and its amendments.

Charges.name: Charges
Charges.definition: Amount and currency of the commissions and changes.

Presentation.name: Presentation
Presentation.definition: Presentation information related to the undertaking.

UndertakingExtension.name: Undertaking Extension
UndertakingExtension.definition: Specifies information related to the extension of an undertaking.
